entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Just tell me how to do it.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not a fault, I just don't need it anymore. My situation changed right after I bought it. I had an emergency and ended up in the hospital.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright.
It is what it is. I had to have unexpected surgery, which means the training for my military deployment is off. So, the band is useless to me now. Can I return it, yes or no?
I understand completely. Thank you for explaining. Let me just pull up your order information and check the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Okay, I see your order here. The VeloBand Pulse was delivered 21 days ago.
And... yes, according to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return. You're well within that timeframe, so I can absolutely process this for a full refund.

I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Simply pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
I see the email. Okay, that's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish you a speedy recovery.
